api.bootstrap_unauthorized: This destination does not authorize creating the project on the server.
api.conversation_other_project: The conversation belongs to another project.
api.conversation_unregistered: The conversation belongs to a checkout not registered in this service.
api.documents_layout: This project needs its documentation imported into the D088 unified contract.
api.host_rejected: The local service only serves loopback names.
api.origin_rejected: Origin different from the local service.
api.phase_unregistered: The phase belongs to a checkout not registered in this service.
api.planning_layout: Definition and planning conversations need the D088 unified documentation contract.
api.ports_unconfigured: No agent ports are configured for the conversation.
api.reader_import: No Git reader is configured to import the project.
api.restored_read_only: Read-only restore; it authorizes no writers and no process resumption.
api.run_unregistered: The run belongs to a checkout not registered in this service.
api.target_identity_changed: The folder stopped being accessible or changed identity; review the operation.
api.task_source_changed: The task is no longer in the document or its text changed; choose it again.
api.writer_batch: This service has no Git writer configured; a batch with commits is not authorized.
api.writer_commit: This service has no Git writer configured; the commit is not queued.
api.writer_documents: Documentation operations need a Git writer.
api.writer_export: The export needs a configured Git writer.
api.writer_phase: This service has no Git writer configured; phase operations are not queued.
api.writer_reconcile: This service has no Git writer configured; the agent reconciliation could not be confirmed and is not queued.
cli.assets_missing: Web assets missing; install the package built with scripts/build_distribution.py.
cli.auxiliary_files: SQLite auxiliary files exist; keep them and use a new destination.
cli.backfill_missing: SQLite does not exist; the backfill does not create databases.
cli.config_conflict: --config and {variable} are incompatible; choose a single composition.
cli.database_missing: SQLite missing; prepare a new database with harness-local init-db --database PATH.
cli.destination_exists: The destination already exists; init-db only prepares a new SQLite database.
cli.port_range: The port must be between 1 and 65535.
preferences.conflict: Preferences changed in another window; reload them before saving.
preferences.invalid: The stored language preferences are invalid; save them again in Preferences before starting new work.
preferences.key_reused: This idempotency key already names a different preferences change.
session.limit: Close a session or restart the service.
session.rate_limited: Wait a minute before trying to sign in again.
session.required: Session missing, closed or expired. Sign in; no action will be repeated automatically.
work_language.confirmed: The work language of this project is already confirmed; it never changes.
work_language.immutable: The work language of {root} is already {language} and never changes.
work_language.pending: The checkout has unfinished or pending work ({items}); resolve it before confirming the work language.
work_language.preview_changed: The preview no longer matches; review it again.
work_language.required: Choose the project's work language (en or es); it is fixed when the project is registered or created.
work_language.unconfirmed: This project has no confirmed work language; confirm it in the project settings before starting new work.
